how_to_apply: Fill the bio-data proforma in Annexure-II and affix a recent passport size photograph.
Get the Head of Office certificate in the proforma signed with seal.
Enclose attested APARs for last five years, certificates, NOC, undertaking and Vigilance/Administrative Clearance.
Write 'Application for the Post of Deputy Director (EDP) on Absorption/Deputation basis' on the envelope.
Send the application through proper channel to Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham on or before 07/12/2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Computer Engineering/Computer Sciences from a recognized university/institution; OR Degree in Maths/Statistics/Operational Research/Economics with Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Application/Computer Science/Information Technology from a recognized university/institution; OR Degree in Engineering with Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Application/Computer Science/Information Technology from a recognized university/institution Experience: Officers holding analogous posts or Assistant Director (EDP)/Assistant Director (Research) and other equivalent posts in the scale of pay of Rs.9100-15100 with five year service in the grade in P&R Division in a Major Port Trust Age limit: Age limit for direct recruits does not apply to absorption/deputation (as on 1 November 2026) Other conditions: Open only to officers of Major Port Authorities on absorption/deputation basis Vigilance report in the prescribed format (Annexure-III) Details of any major or minor penalty in the last 10 years to be sent by the forwarding authority Desirable: Post Graduate Degree in Maths/Statistics/Operational Research/Economics Or Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Systems/Information Systems/MIS/Information Technology/Computer Application Or Business Admn. (PG Degree/Diploma) with specialization in Systems/Information Systems/MIS/Information Technology and allied subjects

content_sections.text: Attested copies of APARs for the last five years Attested copies of all educational and experience certificates No-objection Certificate from the respective Port Undertaking not to withdraw candidature if selected Vigilance/Administrative Clearance from the concerned Port (Annexure-III) Bio-data proforma (Annexure-II) with recent passport size photograph and Head of Office certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DPA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the bio-data proforma in Annexure-II and affix a recent passport size photograph. Get the Head of Office certificate in the proforma signed with seal. Enclose attested APARs for last five years, certificates, NOC, undertaking and Vigilance/Administrative Clearance. Write 'Application for the Post of Deputy Director (EDP) on Absorption/Deputation basis' on the envelope. Send the application through proper channel to Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham on or before 07/12/2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Crucial date for determining eligibility is 01/11/2026 Applicant undertakes not to withdraw and to accept the posting if selected Head of Office must certify ACRs for 01/04/2021 to 31/03/2026

content_sections.heading: DPA Deputy Director (EDP) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Deputy Director (EDP).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (bio-data proforma) and Annexure-III (vigilance clearance form) of this circular; also on the Recruitment Section of the official website) and send it to Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, General Administration Deptt., Administration Office Building, Post Box No.50, Gandhidham (Kachchh), Gujarat - 370201, by through proper channel, in an envelope, to reach by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 50,000-1,60,000 (pre to pre-revised Rs. 10750-16750), Class-I.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in Computer Engineering/Computer Sciences; OR Degree in Maths/Statistics/Operational Research/Economics with PG Diploma in Computer Application/Computer Science/IT; OR Degree in Engineering with PG Diploma in Computer Application/Computer Science/IT, from a recognized university/institution. Officers in analogous posts or Assistant Director (EDP)/Assistant Director (Research) and equivalent posts in scale Rs.9100-15100 with five years' service in the grade in P&R Division in a Major Port.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to officers of Major Port Authorities on absorption/deputation basis. Vigilance report in the prescribed format (Annexure-III). Details of any major or minor penalty in the last 10 years to be sent by the forwarding authority.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not received through proper channel. Applications received after the last date. Applications without APARs or otherwise incomplete.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Recruitment Rules (Annexure-I) list a probation period of 2 years for the post.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham (Kachchh), Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Attested copies of APARs for the last five years; Attested copies of all educational and experience certificates; No-objection Certificate from the respective Port; Undertaking not to withdraw candidature if selected; Vigilance/Administrative Clearance from the concerned Port (Annexure-III); Bio-data proforma (Annexure-II) with recent passport size photograph and Head of Office certificate.
